title: British Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring traditional British sausages in a rich, flavorful sauce. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Cook the British sausages in a pan over medium heat until browned, then set aside.
Peel and chop the carrots and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté the chopped onion in a pan until softened.
Add the cooked sausages, carrots, potatoes, and bacon to the pan.
Pour in the zesty tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the sausages are cooked through.
